Class DeviceHealthCheck

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.checks.DeviceHealthCheck
All Implemented Interfaces:
Check
public final class DeviceHealthCheck extends Object implements Check
Every device answering, none rebooted recently, grouped by bus (or by kind, for coprocessors).

A device is missing once its connected input has been false for MISSING_HOLD_SECONDS, or if it has never answered. A reset counts only while the device is connected, and only once it has been connected for ARM_SECONDS at a stretch: Phoenix reports its first contact with a device as a reset, and a disconnected device's flags mean nothing. A device arms once per boot and stays armed through a dropout, since a brownout reboot reports its reset on the first loop back.

A missing device fails the check unless its DeviceHealthCheck.Device.missingIs(Supplier) says otherwise (a camera that is only logged, not used, warns or is left out). A reboot in the last RECENT_REBOOT_SECONDS warns: the device works now, but its power wiring needs a look before it browns out in a match.
